### Live Google Fonts test

I asked the Conductor to download **Inter** through the visible Boardroom browser on `app.indii.music`, using your existing signed-in account. The Conductor stopped before navigation because it had no browser-control tool. The Live Feed showed no specialist handoff or browser action, and no file downloaded. Spotify for Artists reproduced the iframe restriction, and Pin to Swarm captured only the URL. I used your existing account and did not verify its plan.

### Center workspace

The local update puts **Browser, Studio, Workbench, and Feed** in the center between the table and discussion on desktop. Closing and reopening the pane preserves the browser, and **Open externally** remains available. The update also connects web Workbench storage so a Creative draft can open by its exact filename. The production build and 13,332 local tests passed.

The changes are staged on `codex/boardroom-shared-workspace`. `/go` keeps the batch uncommitted while acceptance is open, so there is no new published SHA. The remaining blocker is a hosted Boardroom browser that can share one visible session with the assigned agent and verify input ownership and downloads. The existing hosted worker is scoped to copyright filing and has downloads disabled.
